analysis.summary: A position paper on benchmarking cloud analytics. It observes that vendor workload traces carry execution telemetry but omit SQL text for privacy, and asks whether realistic workloads can be synthesised from telemetry alone. The authors argue this works at the workload level but not the query level, since telemetry does not uniquely determine query structure, and propose enriching traces with transferable features and building use-case-centric benchmarks instead.
